alertes.actives_aide: Shows the official weather alerts relayed by Vigie on the screen, as long as one is in force.
alertes.adresse_aide: Leave empty to use Vigie’s public service. An address starts with https://.
alertes.niveau_aide: Less serious alerts are not shown.
alertes.periode_aide: The screen asks Vigie for alerts at this pace: 15 minutes by default, 10 at the very least.
appairage.invite: Enter the 6-digit code shown on the device’s screen.
appairage.redemarre: The screen has restarted. Enter the code shown on its screen again.
assistant.aide: Three services: understand your voice, think, speak. Tap one to set it up.
ecran.langue_assistant_aide: The language the assistant understands and speaks.
erreur.appareil_illisible: The device information can’t be read.
erreur.ecran_illisible: The screen settings can’t be read right now.
erreur.injoignable: The screen isn’t responding. Is it on, and on the same Wi-Fi?
erreur.interne: The screen ran into a problem. Try again.
erreur.ne_repond_plus: The screen still isn’t responding. Check that it’s on.
erreur.reglages_gros: This file is too big to be a settings backup.
erreur.test_long: The test is taking too long. Try again.
erreur.wifi_illisible: The Wi-Fi settings can’t be read right now.
maj.redemarre: The screen is restarting. This page will reconnect by itself…
maj.retour_confirm: The screen will restart with version {version}.
mer.deja: This spot is already in your list.
mer.injoignable: Can’t reach Vigie to read the list of spots. Check the address in “{carte}”.
mer.pleine: Your list is full: {n} spots at most. Remove one to add another.
mer.vent_aide: For the kite verdict. 12 to 25 knots by default.
mer.vent_entiers: Each field must contain a whole number of knots.
mer.vide: No spot chosen: the screen doesn’t show the sea.
meteo.attribution_metno: Weather data: {lien} (CC BY 4.0 and NLOD 2.0 licenses, data adapted)
meteo.sans_parrainage: This device is not endorsed or sponsored by the National Weather Service.
reg.ressaisir: Remember to re-enter the key for: {services}.
reg.sans_cle_aide: The backup contains no access key and no password.
source.aide: The service that provides the weather for the chosen city.
source.filtre: Only sources that cover the city’s country are offered.
source.repli: {service} is unavailable: the weather comes from Open-Meteo for now.
source.retablie: Source set back to “Automatic”: the previous one doesn’t cover this country.
svc.cle_aide: Once saved, the key is never shown again.
svc.cle_effacee: The key will be deleted when you save.
svc.local_aide: Replace “localhost” with your PC’s address, for example 192.168.1.20.
ville.aide_aucune: The screen works out the weather and the time from it.
wifi.reconnectez: Reconnect your phone to your Wi-Fi, then open {adresse}.
